title: LangChain Repository Overview
summary: LangChain is a framework for developing applications powered by large language models (LLMs). It simplifies the process of integrating LLMs with external data sources, computation, and agents, enabling developers to build complex, context-aware, and reasoning-capable AI systems. The framework provides modular components for prompt management, LLM integrations, data handling, agent orchestration, and comprehensive observability tools.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Developer / User
nodes.description: Interacts with LangChain to build, run, and monitor LLM-powered applications, defining prompts, orchestrating agents, and evaluating performance.

nodes.label: Core Abstractions & Utilities
nodes.title: Core Abstractions & Utilities
nodes.description: Provides foundational interfaces, base classes, and essential utilities that underpin the entire LangChain ecosystem, enabling core functionalities, API management, security, and performance enhancements.

nodes.label: LLM Interaction & Data Handling
nodes.title: LLM Interaction & Data Handling
nodes.description: This module encompasses all components for interacting with Large Language Models, from crafting prompts and integrating various providers to parsing their outputs. It also includes utilities for text processing, data loading, and storage to support LLM applications.

nodes.label: Agent & Workflow Orchestration
nodes.title: Agent & Workflow Orchestration
nodes.description: This module provides the core components for building intelligent agents and orchestrating complex workflows. It includes various agent types, chains for structured tasks, runnables for flexible composition, and middleware for enhancing agent behavior, security, and context management.

nodes.label: Observability & Evaluation
nodes.title: Observability & Evaluation
nodes.description: This module provides comprehensive tools for monitoring, tracing, and evaluating LangChain applications. It includes callback handlers for event processing, a robust framework for assessing LLM outputs and agent trajectories, and seamless integration with LangSmith for enhanced observability and dataset-driven evaluation.

nodes.label: Memory & State Management
nodes.title: Memory & State Management
nodes.description: This module provides various memory implementations for managing conversational history and state in AI applications, including simple buffers, summarization, vector store-backed memory, and entity tracking.
